disclaimer: Fictional demo products for a bootcamp. Not real insurance.

products.name: Weekly Accident Cover
products.pays: A one-time lump sum equal to your cover amount if you die or become permanently disabled in an accident, and up to 20% of it if an accident puts you in hospital for 24+ hours.
products.formula: (cover/1000) x 0.08 x occupation_factor x hours_factor x night_factor, rounded UP to whole rupees
products.not_covered: Won't pay for repairs or theft of your bike, illness, or accidents while riding without a valid licence or under alcohol.

products.name: Daily Hospital Cash
products.pays: A fixed cash amount for each day you are admitted to hospital, up to 7 days per event, from an accident or illness.
products.formula: (daily/100) x 0.9 x occupation_factor_b x age_factor, rounded UP to whole rupees
products.not_covered: Won't pay for doctor visits without hospital admission, illness in the first 48 hours, or conditions you already had in the first 90 days.
